A '''tomb''' on a remote planet was the final resting place of [[Bruhn]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who succumbed to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. To protect the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Bruhn imprisoned himself on the fringe planet until his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Fallen Jedi}}</ref>
